hero.title: Your Business. Online Strong.
hero.subtitle: LocalGrow sets up your business's complete online presence — professional website, Google profile, WhatsApp customer enquiries, and a smooth digital experience.

benefits.title: What will you get?
benefits.subtitle: We handle all technical complexities so you can focus on serving your customers. Here are 6 core deliverables:
benefits.card1Desc: Your business instantly looks credible, established, and premium to every visitor.
benefits.card2Desc: Nearby local customers can easily discover your business on Google Search and Maps.
benefits.card3Desc: Interested prospects can start a conversation on WhatsApp with just one tap.
benefits.card4Desc: One-tap direct calling and precise Google Maps directions straight to your doorstep.
benefits.card5Desc: Fast, clean, and seamlessly optimized for all smartphones and screen sizes.
benefits.card6Desc: You don't need to understand hosting, DNS, coding, or servers. We manage it all.

problemSolution.title: Your Business Today vs With LocalGrow
problemSolution.subtitle: Competitors capture online customers because their setup is already in place. LocalGrow puts you ahead.
problemSolution.p1: No website — customers hesitate to trust an unverified business
problemSolution.p2: Incomplete Google profile or hard to find in local searches
problemSolution.p3: Customers cannot find your services, photos, or pricing
problemSolution.p4: No easy way for customers to reach you instantly via WhatsApp
problemSolution.p5: Nearby competitors look more modern online and capture your walk-ins
problemSolution.s1: A high-speed, modern website that runs flawlessly on every phone
problemSolution.s2: Complete and optimized Google profile for immediate local discovery
problemSolution.s3: Clear services catalog, transparent pricing, and sharp photo gallery
problemSolution.s4: Direct WhatsApp chat and instant calling buttons on every screen
problemSolution.s5: Your business stands out as the most reputable and modern in the area

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.subtitle: A transparent 5-step roadmap. No complicated paperwork, no endless meetings.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Share your business name, services, location, photos, and contact information.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We design your website, set up your Google presence, and configure WhatsApp enquiry flows.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Check the private preview and request any revisions, text tweaks, or adjustments.
howItWorks.step4Desc: We connect your custom business domain and publish your brand on the internet.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Google Search → Website → WhatsApp/Call → Real customer enquiries and walk-ins!

services.title: What do we do for your business?
services.subtitle: Every service is laser-focused on one objective: building customer trust and driving real enquiries.
services.s1Desc: Ultra-fast, beautifully designed, and looking professional on phones, tablets, and desktops.
services.s2Desc: Accurate setup of your address, operating hours, phone numbers, and categories on Google Maps.
services.s3Desc: Direct click-to-chat WhatsApp button so customers can message without saving your number.
services.s4Desc: Prominent one-tap call button — customers tap their screen and ring you directly.
services.s5Desc: Exact location pinpoint so customers find their way to your shop or clinic without confusion.
services.s6Desc: A practical, hassle-free strategy to gather genuine 5-star reviews from happy clients.
services.s7Desc: An attractive visual showcase of your actual work, staff, shop floor, or clinical setup.
services.s8Desc: Clear breakdown of what you offer and your pricing, giving customers immediate clarity.
services.s9Desc: A streamlined 30-second form allowing potential clients to submit inquiries instantly.
services.s10Desc: Location-based tags and keywords so residents searching in your city discover you first.

customerJourney.title: How does a customer find you?
customerJourney.subtitle: Here is the exact journey from a local phone search to a paying customer:
customerJourney.j1Desc: A customer searches on mobile: 'Best salon near me' or 'Dental clinic in Mohali'.
customerJourney.j2Desc: Your verified business profile, star rating, and website link appear on Google.
customerJourney.j3Desc: Your clean, fast website loads immediately without lag or clutter.
customerJourney.j4Desc: The customer views your services, photos, pricing, and operating hours.
customerJourney.j5Desc: Seeing a verified profile, reviews, and clear details builds immediate confidence.
customerJourney.j6Desc: With a single tap, the customer messages your WhatsApp or places a direct call.
customerJourney.j7Desc: The appointment or order is confirmed, and they visit your physical location.

whyUs.title: Why work with LocalGrow?
whyUs.subtitle: We are not a bloated corporate IT agency that speaks in confusing acronyms.
whyUs.w1Desc: No technical jargon. We handle servers, hosting, and DNS quietly behind the scenes.
whyUs.w2Desc: The price you see is the exact price you pay. No hidden asterisks or surprises.
whyUs.w3Desc: Domain, hosting, and setup are clearly listed upfront. Nothing sprung on you later.
whyUs.w4Desc: We do not build vanity art projects. We build functional assets that drive customer inquiries.
whyUs.w5Desc: We understand local budgets, commercial realities, and daily vendor workflows.
whyUs.w6Desc: No automated ticketing bots. Reach us directly by phone or WhatsApp whenever needed.

pricing.title: Transparent Plans. No Hidden Costs.
pricing.subtitle: No 'Call for price' runarounds. Clear inclusions upfront for every tier:
pricing.plan2F1: 4–5 Pages Professional Website (Home, About, Services, Gallery, Contact)
pricing.plan2F10: In-depth Local SEO for your City & Services

transparency.title: We hide absolutely nothing.
transparency.subtitle: Many agencies hold domains hostage or demand inflated renewal fees. We believe in complete honesty:
transparency.t1Desc: Your custom domain is registered under your business name. You are always the true owner.
transparency.t2Desc: Hosting for the first 12 months is included in your one-time setup price. No separate hosting bill.
transparency.t3Desc: After Year 1, you only pay standard third-party renewal charges (~₹2,500 - ₹3,500/year for domain & hosting).
transparency.t4Desc: If you require extra custom features outside your package, costs are stated clearly before work starts.
transparency.t5Desc: We do not claim 'guaranteed #1 Google ranking in 7 days'. We build solid, legitimate local business foundations.
transparency.y1Desc: Website + Domain + Hosting + Complete setup published live.
transparency.y2Desc: Standard domain & hosting renewal. Zero surprise setup fees.
transparency.y3Desc: Your website runs continuously, bringing recurring local inquiries.
